en: The postcard features a large action photograph of a cross‑country skier wearing Olympic bib number 63, red racing mittens, a black cap, and goggles. The Olympic rings are visible on her racing bib. At the top left is the name "KRISTINA ŠMIGUN". Near the lower left is a black autograph. In the lower right corner, there is a printed commemorative stamp block showing a smaller portrait of the same skier, the Olympic rings, skis with the word "ESTI" or "EESTI", denomination values, and various postal markings, including a circular cancellation with text. The design celebrates Kristina Šmigun's Olympic achievements.
